suggestions.description: Catalog tri-state tags use plus/minus prefixes instead of the specified check/cross symbols.
evidence: In pw5--catalog-tag-1.png, the included Adventure chip has a white plus prefix on black.
In pw5--catalog-tag-2.png, the excluded Adventure chip has a minus prefix within its dashed, struck-through control.

HANDOFF.md:129 prescribes a checkmark for inclusion and a cross for exclusion. The authoritative static expression at prototype/pw-source.dc.html:191 uses those same marks. Both case metadata files declare no intentional differences.
suggestions.recommendation: Render the required checkmark for include and cross for exclude in the catalog tag controls, retaining the existing inverse include fill and dashed, struck-through exclude treatment. Keep the 0/1/-1 state and real result counts unchanged.

limitations: All eight listed candidate PNGs were individually opened with view_image. No other PNG or independent per-state reference image was opened. This supplemental review does not claim pixel matching or exact screenshot equivalence.

Get-FileHash confirmed that every current candidate SHA-256 matches both the input's expected hash and its case sidecar's screenshot evidence hash. All sidecars identify run a1baf3fe3dc2 and the binary/source hashes recorded above.

The review used static requirements from docs/DESIGN_HANDOFF.md, docs/review/phase3-reference-scope.json, docs/review/phase3-prototype-reference-support.json, and the supplied HANDOFF.md and relevant prototype text. The prototype was not executed.

Existing sidecar checks support case identity and state interpretation; they were not rerun and do not replace the visual observations. A still image cannot establish outside-dismiss event routing, full-control press feedback, or the complete pause/resume and filter interaction sequences.

No application, build, test, smoke check, or runtime probe was run locally or remotely for this review. No physical wake behavior, e-ink waveform behavior, or 512 MiB memory qualification is inferred from these PNGs.

This batch contains no closed-reader, authentication, or image-quality settings capture. It therefore makes no visual finding about the artwork-only reader override, unavailable authorization flows, or hardware controls outside the visible settings fragment.
The findings apply only to these eight supplemental cases and do not establish that the full round is clean.
